# Template attribution

The files `tmlr.sty`, `tmlr.bst`, and `fancyhdr.sty` are unmodified copies from the [official TMLR style repository](https://github.com/JmlrOrg/tmlr-style-file). The TMLR author guide links to that repository. The files are a snapshot of its `main` archive.

The supplied Apache License 2.0 is retained as `LICENSE`. The files `tmlr.bst` and `fancyhdr.sty` contain separate LaTeX Project Public License notices and copyright attribution. Those notices remain in the files. The template authors and package authors are not manuscript authors.
